title: Data Protection: Cloud KMS, Sensitive Data Protection & Encryption — D4
purpose: Shows identities, trust boundaries, policy checks, and audit evidence.
routing_rationale: Comprehensive data protection requires securing data at rest with customer-managed cryptographic keys (CMEK) while automatically identifying and pseudonymizing sensitive PII before analytical persistence.

nodes.label: Cloud HSM Key Ring
nodes.detail: Hardware security module storing root encryption keys with automatic annual rotation.

nodes.label: Data Encryption Key (DEK)
nodes.detail: Generates local AES-256 keys to encrypt raw records; wrapped by Key Encryption Key (KEK).

nodes.label: Cloud DLP Inspect Engine
nodes.detail: Scans raw files using built-in infoTypes to identify social security and credit card numbers.

nodes.label: Crypto-Tokenization Engine
nodes.detail: Replaces sensitive SSN with encrypted token: TOKEN_#8921_x9f preserving format.

nodes.label: Sanitized BigQuery Data
nodes.detail: Stores tokenized analytical records encrypted at rest using Cloud KMS HSM key.

edges.label: 1. Wrap Local DEK with HSM KEK

steps.title: Envelope Encryption & Key Wrapping
steps.action: Cloud KMS generates wrapped DEK for BigQuery storage encryption.
steps.why_traversal: Delivers cryptographic key ownership with zero performance degradation on large tables.

steps.title: PII Inspection & Tokenization
steps.action: Cloud DLP scans payload, identifies sensitive infoTypes, tokenizes them, and writes to BigQuery.
steps.why_traversal: Allows analysts to query sanitized data without exposing raw PII.

scenarios.label: Emergency CMEK Revocation Shuts Down Access
scenarios.root_cause: Security incident response officer disabled the KEK in Cloud KMS.
scenarios.diverted_path: All reads and writes to BigQuery instantly blocked across all users.
scenarios.recovery: Re-enable KEK version in Cloud KMS once security threat is resolved.
